rationale: Board-game engines rapidly integrate positional features into coherent evaluations and pattern recognition of threats/structures, executing this ability's core sub-tasks at superhuman speed in the game domain; FRS scores this pair 1.00.

Reading comprehension can integrate evidence from multiple parts of a passage or several documents, which weakly touches the 'multiple sources of information' aspect, but the ability's core is real-time attentional switching between concurrent activities, which the application neither performs nor offloads.

The application's core loop is planning and executing digital tool/code tasks, not perceiving live human reactions; any inference about others' motives is incidental to text it processes, and it lacks the real-time multimodal and contextual cues social perceptiveness depends on.

Speech recognition transcribes audio and involves no motor output; rapid repetitive finger/hand/wrist movement is entirely outside its input-output pipeline (dictation may substitute for typing in some workflows, but it does not support the motor ability itself).

Self-play trained agents induce general positional principles and evaluation heuristics from vast numbers of specific games, and their learned value/policy networks generalize patterns to unseen states—the core of forming general rules from combined pieces of information—though the induction is confined to fixed-rule discrete domains rather than open-ended relational inference.

Speech recognition only transcribes what a customer or colleague says; it removes a listening barrier and can feed downstream help workflows, but it does not itself identify needs or generate helpful action, which is the core of service orientation.
Image generation produces pixels from prompts and has no physical actuation, so it cannot grasp, manipulate, or assemble small objects; it is a purely digital output with no motor component.

VQA over wide-field or multi-camera imagery can detect and report objects and motion at the edges of a scene without needing a fixated gaze, substituting for the detection function of peripheral vision, though it lacks the continuous real-time alerting tied to a moving observer.
Board-game search and position evaluation operate on discrete symbolic states with no audio input or language understanding, so the application contributes nothing to recognizing spoken speech.

Reading a supplied passage supports detecting stated inconsistencies, missing evidence, or contradictions within documents, which covers a slice of problem recognition; but problem sensitivity mostly depends on monitoring live situations, non-textual cues, and contextual baselines the model never receives.
Night vision is a low-light visual sensory capacity; a text-passage question-answering system involves no imaging or perception of any kind and cannot substitute for or augment seeing in darkness.

A text-only language model can compose, phrase, and organize the verbal content of spoken communication (scripts, talking points, explanations tailored to an audience), but it cannot produce speech itself or handle delivery, prosody, and real-time interactive adaptation, which are core to oral expression.
Trunk Strength is a purely physical muscular endurance capacity requiring a body; a still-image labelling model provides no actuation or substitute for core muscle support.
The application produces code patches from text issues; it involves no spoken output or articulation, so it does nothing for the motor-vocal task of speaking intelligibly.

The agent outputs abstract control commands rather than coordinating physical limbs; only a loose analogy exists between simultaneous multi-channel game inputs and limb coordination, and the FRS pattern scores physical/motor abilities at zero for this application.

The system holds and applies vast stores of definitions, theorems, formulas and procedures, effectively substituting for a human's need to memorize technical content, but it does not train or perform recall of arbitrary personal/episodic material and its retention is not the core of what it does (derivation is).
